mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates on equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline is not sustained over 3 months, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p>0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises above 4.5% in the next three months, labor market strength and reduced unemployment expectations drive upward pressure on equity prices, resulting in positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE fails to rise above 4.5% in 3 months, or 20-day returns are not positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in FEDFUNDS rates and increases in GDPC1 (demand) signal dual accommodative policy and robust economic activity, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not decline while GDPC1 rises, or 60-day returns are not positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS exceeding 136,000 in the next month indicates strong labor demand, boosting corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to positive 5-day returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS remains ≤136,000 in next month, or 5-day returns are not positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO (supply) alongside falling FEDFUNDS rates suggests an expanding economy with accommodative policy, reducing inflationary pressures and supporting equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise while FEDFUNDS falls, or 20-day returns are not positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, simultaneous rises in INDPRO (supply) and HOUST (demand) create overvaluation risks, prompting risk aversion and negative 60-day returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle regime, INDPRO and HOUST do not both rise, or 60-day returns are positive (p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS rates above 4.5% signal monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS falls below 4.5% before 20 days, or 20-day returns are not negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in UNRATE (labor) and GDPC1 (demand) reflect strengthening labor markets and robust economic growth, driving positive 5-day returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE and GDPC1 do not both rise, or 5-day returns are not positive (p>0.05).
